subject.title: feat(doctor): add narrow deterministic gating check

question: Should this PR keep the added doctor-lint test command in the recurring check-guards CI shard, or should it limit the change to the comparator plus regression coverage?
rationale: The comparator change is narrow and in the right code path, but check-guards placement affects automation runtime and failure surface and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep source/test only
options.body: Remove the check-guards workflow command and let normal doctor test lanes cover the comparator until a CI owner sponsors recurring guard coverage.

options.title: Accept the CI guard
options.body: Keep the workflow command after branch refresh and tied-order proof if maintainers want this deterministic lint check in check-guards.

options.title: Pause for CI owner review
options.body: Leave the PR open until a CI owner explicitly chooses whether check-guards is the right shard for this coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep source/test only
recommendation.body: Remove the check-guards workflow command and let normal doctor test lanes cover the comparator until a CI owner sponsors recurring guard coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CI workflow history makes this the best available routing candidate for check-guards placement.
